description: Multi-Hazard Flash Flood and Landslide Early Warning & Evacuation Decision Support System

subsystems.name: Web Frontend
responsibilities: Direct Command Center launch on root route (/) redirection to /dashboard
Authoritative Timeline View (TimelineView.tsx) with past observed vs future projected horizons
Multi-horizon projection grid (+1h to +48h) with calibrated probabilities
Hydrological CWC river dynamics and gauge progression meters
Catchment exposure & evacuation shelter elevation advantage matrix
First Responder incident command console (ResponderPage.tsx)
Citizen mobile warning portal (CitizenWarning.tsx)
GIS Leaflet multi-hazard map overlays and live 24H rainfall telemetry

subsystems.name: API & Domain Services
responsibilities: 17 REST API routers with RBAC authentication
Regional ML predictions router (/api/v1/regional/predict)
Timeline analytics service with continuous piecewise threshold lead-time solver
Platt and Isotonic calibrated multi-horizon risk predictions (+1h to +48h)
Multi-hazard landslide empirical threshold assessment
Hazard-weighted Dijkstra A* evacuation route solver with off-network snapping
Concurrency-safe alert lifecycle engine with database unique constraint
Deterministic 20-substep scenario runner and historical replay

subsystems.name: Machine Learning Subsystem
responsibilities: Multi-Region Model Registry supporting 10 Indian agro-climatic zones
Feature engineering pipeline with 15 canonical features
Deterministic event-based holdout train/test split across Himalayan states
Calibrated probability estimation with reliability curves and ECE evaluation
Authentic feature attributions using marginal log-odds and TreeSHAP
Sub-15ms real-time inference service with hydrologic fallback

subsystems.name: Data Storage & Ingestion
responsibilities: Dual-engine relational storage (SQLite/PostgreSQL)
15,624 continuous hourly ERA5 meteorological observations
IndoFloods catchment characteristics and flood catalog
Beas Basin historical disaster records
Dynamic village hierarchy querying
